en: Colored illustrated postcard showing a hilltop baroque church with twin towers and red domes labeled "Maria Trost." A long stairway leads up through trees from a park-like area below. In the foreground are buildings and pavilions of a leisure or spa establishment with people walking and sitting outdoors. Decorative lettering at the lower right reads "Etablissement Weitzer." There is cursive handwriting across the lower margin.
